items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Of course, we were talking about that tonight, how old my oldest boy was. But I don't think it was 21 when we come out. William wasn't born in 21.

ctx.x: Eddie Robison. Oh, he was a good one. He's the one that Robeshoe's drummer taught how to play drums. Walter Bundy. That was Robeshoe's drummer. Then he taught Eddie Robison how to play drums. Zoo, Eddie Robison, myself, John Porter, you heard of him, he's in the Orleans, Bond in the Orleans, bass, and Dave, Dave Jones wasn't the microphone. That's right. One of the sweetest melaphone players you've ever wanted yet. Well, I brought away a brass band. And all the men that I couldn't get to fill the band, like Reed…
